purpose: Diagnose the accepted NumPy baseline; no performance implementation or production edits
algorithm: A: original hardware.walking_preflight.RuntimeBeamEvidence; no Numba import or replacement

calibration.design: Six balanced paired A/A runs for EACH mode; M=minimal common replay observer, D=diagnostic observer; identical algorithm, input, GUI and camera
calibration.failure_rule: If observer calibration fails, do not use D for quantitative baseline inference; retain all failed rounds and reduce probe or report uncertainty. Individual slow rounds never removed.

phases: Freeze from source before timing: classify copied contact bits after applying only existing preflight frozen bad_indices (both recordings have always-blocked beam 576). Original frames remain intact. Armed one-second device windows: dense>=50% frames with any usable contact; empty<=1%; mixed otherwise. Empty-before and empty-after separate; retain whole armed results.
exclusive_accounting: Sample a full synchronous quality root every 64 frames. Subtract direct measured child inclusive times; do not add nested inclusive totals. Batch metrics separate from sampled stage extrapolation. Diagnostic overhead and residual uninstrumented helpers explicitly retained.
scheduling: Record drain boundaries, pending backlog, zero/5ms timer state, Qt dispatcher awake/aboutToBlock, CPU vs wall, queue age and reader scheduled-arrival lag; gaps with pending input are scheduling/GIL/OS combined, not pure Qt delay.
gil: Independent external py-spy sampling on separate native GUI runs; GIL-owner stacks are evidence of contention opportunity, not proof of the full non-CPU duration. Do not assign every wall-minus-thread-CPU nanosecond to GIL.
correctness: All delivered raw bits/wire/counters/order equal source; full report equal independent synchronous baseline oracle and A/A; only two independently verified receipt clocks normalized. Runtime counts/transitions/final windows, quality events and processor audit preserved.
latency_scope: Qt paint completion, not physical scanout; run has 7 touches, walk has 10. Report P95/max and sample size, without significance claims.
same_source_gui: Frozen replay source from parent experiment, same recorded cadence and recorded camera decode/pose/overlay; physical USB/camera drivers absent. No synthesized 1000Hz or scene changes in timing trials.
output: Reviewable exclusive-cost attribution with evidence-ranked causes and exactly one minimal NEXT experiment; no optimization implementation
cpu_clock_update_before_gui_trials: Windows GetThreadTimes 2000 x ~50us busy observations: 1998 zero increments, 2 increments of15.625ms. Do not use per-call thread_time as compute time or subtract it to infer GIL. Add QueryThreadCycleTime via PyDLL for raw non-overlapping CPU-cycle costs; never convert cycles to elapsed time.
media_scope: Run retains previous raw JPEG+CSV. Walk losslessly demuxes existing tinyse_20261014_231141.avi MJPEG packets, using archived relative timestamps; original raw JPEGs and precise first-frame offset unavailable. Same byte-identical archive in every walking A/A.
